An’ we munnot lose no time about it.” When he was very much interested he often spoke quite broad Yorkshire though at other times he tried to modify his dialect so that Mary could better understand. But she loved his broad Yorkshire and had in fact been trying to learn to speak it herself. So she spoke a little now. “Aye, that we mun,” she said (which meant “Yes, indeed, we must”).
